items.title: Gucci cuts prices, but will Chinese shoppers return?
items.summary: Jing Daily (Lisa Nan) analyzes Gucci's early-September mainland China price cuts of up to ~30-40% on select bags and apparel, arguing cautious Chinese consumers are adopting a wait-and-see stance for further reductions and increasingly favor gold over branded leather goods. Frames it as a test of whether pricing alone can restore purchase confidence amid the broader 'quiet luxury' shift away from logo-heavy pieces.

items.title: Gucci taglia i prezzi fino al 30% in Cina per sostenere le vendite
items.summary: Italian trade outlet Pambianco corroborates the China repricing, citing Mercato tote and Ophidia mini bucket bag cuts of roughly 22-29%, and ties the move to Kering CEO Luca de Meo's repositioning strategy after Gucci's H1 2026 revenue declined amid the Asia-Pacific slowdown.

items.title: 「グッチ」が新作スモールレザーグッズを発売 ホースビットやダブルGなど3シリーズ
items.summary: WWD Japan covers Gucci's three new small-leather-goods lines (Horsebit, GG Marmont/Double-G, and Web-stripe) launching October 1 in Japan, timed to the 'Issaku Manbai' lucky-money-day tradition; card cases from roughly 60,500 yen and small wallets up to 108,900 yen. Straightforward product/PR coverage.

items.title: BTSのジンを起用 グッチの新キャンペーン「Gucci Primavera」公開
items.summary: FashionSnap reports on Gucci's 'Gucci Primavera' FW2026 campaign visuals featuring ten global faces including BTS' Jin, aespa's Ningning, Xiao Zhan, Sean Mendes and Rico Nasty; standard ambassador/campaign PR coverage relevant to the NEA fanbase-driven engagement channel (K-pop/C-pop ambassadors).

items.title: 구찌, AI 모델 화보 공개에 논란..."촌스럽고 엉성" 비판 확산
items.summary: Korean outlet Dailian reports backlash to Gucci's AI-generated model imagery posted ahead of Milan Fashion Week, with online critics calling the visuals cheap 'AI slop' and noting the irony of a brand claiming to honor Italian craftsmanship while excluding human models and photographers. Held in pool as background context for the AI-campaign controversy narrative still circulating in KR community threads, though outside the strict freshness window (flagged, not primary weight).

items.source: Weibo user (奢侈品观察类账号)
items.title: 古驰突然大降价：最高降40%！经典款跌破万元，还能买吗？
items.summary: Weibo luxury-commentary account discusses whether it's still worth buying Gucci now that classic bags have dropped below RMB10,000 after the ~40% cuts; comment threads reflect mixed reaction between bargain-hunters and skeptics who see it as a sign of declining brand prestige.

items.source: 小红书 (Xiaohongshu) user discussion, cited via search aggregation
items.title: 最高降幅超40%！古驰Gucci多款包包成衣罕见降价
items.summary: Shenmezhide (什么值得买) consumer community post rounds up the Gucci China price cuts with user comments skewing skeptical: representative replies argue money is better spent on travel/experiences, or on secondhand Gucci at half price, than on new discounted pieces, questioning the brand's value retention.

items.title: 명품 갤러리 - 구찌 관련 스레드 (디시인사이드)
items.summary: Korean forum DCInside's luxury board (명품 갤러리) carries ongoing threads referencing Gucci alongside counterfeit/replica comparison discussion common on this board; general community chatter mixing genuine product discussion with replica-market commentary. Included as a community-channel data point though individual thread-level engagement metrics are not visible from the board index.

items.title: Let's dissect Gucci's new movie under Demna, "The Tiger"
items.summary: Culted's critical review dissects Demna's 33-minute Gucci film 'The Tiger' (starring Demi Moore, Edward Norton, Alex Consani, Kendall Jenner), praising the styling's Vinterberg-esque chaos-dinner-party tone while questioning whether film-over-runway is a sustainable format for a house still trying to reverse a multi-year sales slide; useful counterweight to purely promotional coverage of the Demna era.
